<function name="GetNavAreaCount" parent="navmesh" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns the total count of nav areas on the map. If you want to get all nav areas, use <page>navmesh.GetAllNavAreas</page> instead as nav areas IDs are not always sequential.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The total count of nav areas on the map.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
